prompt: A young East Asian woman with long, wavy dark brown hair stands outdoors in a mountainous landscape, looking back over her shoulder at the camera with a gentle smile. The background features majestic snow-capped mountains under a partly cloudy sky, with golden autumn larch trees on the left side of the frame. The lighting is soft and natural, suggesting late afternoon or early evening. A small white watermark text "Xuefei" appears on the lower-left portion of the backpack.
